IRVINE, Calif., Aug. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kura Sushi USA, Inc. (“Kura Sushi” or the “Company”), (NASDAQ: KRUS), a technology-enabled Japanese restaurant concept, today announced that it will participate in the following conferences:


- On Tuesday, September 8, 2026, the Company will host a fireside chat at the Barclays 19th Annual Global Consumer Conference in Boston, MA. Kura’s discussion will begin at 2:15 p.m. ET.
- On Tuesday, September 15, 2026, the Company will host a fireside chat at the Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference in Nashville, TN. Kura’s discussion will begin at 3:30 p.m. CT.


The Company will also be meeting with institutional investors at these conferences.


**About Kura Sushi USA, Inc.**
Kura Sushi USA, Inc. is a leading technology-enabled Japanese restaurant concept with 95 locations across 24 states and Washington DC. The Company offers guests a distinctive dining experience built on authentic Japanese cuisine and an engaging revolving sushi service model. Kura Sushi USA, Inc. was established in 2008 as a subsidiary of Kura Sushi, Inc., a Japan-based revolving sushi chain with more than 650 restaurants internationally and 45 years of brand history. For more information, please visit **[www.kurasushi.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9s6BieCzPCmk2PAY3eqgpZI5Q6ngfOqv2ij6pziPx4muvJCF2VBK91AkDSxxaFoGiqRA3CQBBw9alSQdg3FPHY-9d6ml8fiXwLI7CrpCftk=)** .
